header.running_head: Getting Annoyed for the Sake of One's Elders

blocks.text: is telling the truth while you people are false. I swear by Allaah that Abu Bakr was purer than musk while I am in need of more guidance than our family's camel."[^1]

Hadhrat Hasan reports that Hadhrat Umar (RA) had appointed informants amongst the masses who once informed him that a group of people had gathered and claimed that he (Hadhrat Umar (RA)) was better then Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) became very angry and sent for these people. When they were brought, Hadhrat Umar (RA) addressed them saying, "O you most wretched of people! You most wretched of your tribes! You corrupters of an impregnable fortress!" Surprised, they enquired, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Why are you telling us this? What have we done?" After repeating himself three times, Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "Why have you created a division between Abu Bakr Siddeeq (RA) and myself? I swear by the Being Who controls my life that I wish I could reach even that position of Jannah from where I can see Abu Bakr (RA) at the furthest point of my sight."[^2]

Another narration states that Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "Abu Bakr (RA) is the best of this Ummah after its Nabi ﷺ. Whoever claims otherwise after this proclamation of mine is a slanderer and shall be punished as slanderers are punished."[^3] A narration of Hadhrat Ziyaad bin Ilaaqah states that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once overheard someone saying (about him), "This man is the best of this Ummah after its Nabi ﷺ." Hadhrat Umar (RA) started hitting the man with his whip saying, "This wretch is lying! Abu Bakr (RA) is definitely better than me, my father, yourself and your father!"[^4]
Hadhrat Ali (RA) Rebukes a Person who Regarded him to Be Superior to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Abu Zinaad narrates that someone once asked Hadhrat Ali (RA), "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! What is the matter with the Muhaajireen and Ansaar? They regard Abu Bakr (RA) as being superior to you whereas your virtues are more, you had accepted Islaam before him and have excelled him." Hadhrat Ali (RA) asked, "If you belong to the Quraysh tribe, I assume that you must be from the Aa'idha family." When the man confirmed that he was, Hadhrat Ali (RA) said, "Had a Mu'min not been in the protection of Allaah, I would have certainly had you executed. If you were to survive, I would then chastise you in a manner that you would be unable to escape. Shame on you! Abu Bakr (RA) excelled me in four matters (especially). He was appointed to the position of being Imaam before me when Rasulullaah ﷺ put him forward as Imaam. (Secondly,) He made Hijrah before me, (thirdly) he beat me to the cave (to be with Rasulullaah ﷺ during the Hijrah) and (fourthly) he also proclaimed his Islaam before me.
Abu Nu'aym in his Fadhaa'ilus Sahabah (RA), as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.4 Pg.350).
